text: thanks, scholarship tidy!
index the proper names in the back, not every noun
set index proper names page numbers
can you collapse the duplicate index entries under one head word
then promote the frequent sub entries to head words
set index merge duplicates promote frequent
again keep the fine grained entries this time
tell me how fat the index is in pages
drop in a see also chain for the process entries
set see also italic indented
line the index head words up bold
instead of bold make head words small caps
show what changed to the index pages
next cut the index by a third, drop the vanity entries
set index trim vanity terms
I wonder if the ebook index needs page anchors instead
make the index anchor based for the ebook build
thanks, back of the book works!
set font code mono 9 with light gray background
can you keep the code blocks from hyphenating
then turn on soft wrap only, no scroll
set code wrap soft no horizontal scroll
again shrink long lines to 80 columns this time
tell me which code block overflows the page
drop in line numbers in the left gutter of the code
set code line numbers gray right aligned
line the code captions up as listing 1, listing 2
instead of listing use example
show what changed to the listings
next add syntax highlighting in muted colors
set syntax colors muted comments green
please make the columns of the inline code not stretch tables
I wonder if the tables with code cells need smaller font
make the code cells 8 point mono
thanks, technical sections hold together!
that would help the reviewers.
key the keywords bold on their first appearance
set keywords bold first appearance only
can you add a glossary link on jargon at first use
then build the glossary from those links, sorted
set glossary auto built from links alphabetical
again include acronyms this time, expanded on first use
tell me which acronyms never got expanded
highest first: list jargon by how often it appears
line the glossary entries up term bold definition regular
instead of one column make the glossary two columns
show what changed to the glossary pages
next add the glossary to the TOC, level one
set TOC glossary entry level 1
I wonder if the glossary should open the doc instead of the abstract
make the order: cover, glossary, abstract, then the rest
thanks, jargon demystified!
spell out the numbers under ten in prose
set number style prose under ten spelled
can you leave the numbers in tables and figures alone
then also leave the units and dates alone
set exceptions tables figures units dates
again spell under one hundred this time, formal doc
tell me where the style conflicts with itself
drop in a style sheet note at the top for future editors
set style note comment only not printed
line the numbers in prose consistent with the style
instead of the comment keep it as an unnumbered page
show what changed to chapter three
next normalize the dates to day month year
set date format day month year prose
please make the columns of the dates in the log table equal
I wonder if iso dates read too robot for prose
make prose dates human, table dates iso
thanks, numbers and dates coherent!
set the last chapter in two columns with a rule between them
set two columns rule thin gap 18
can you balance the columns on the final page
then let the first page flow naturally unbalanced
set columns balance last page only
again balance everywhere this time
tell me how the figures survive two column layout
drop in a full width figure that spans both columns
set spanning figure full width caption centered
line the column footnotes up per column, not per page
instead of per column restart them per chapter
show what changed to the back pages
next widen the gutter to 20 for print
set gutter 20 print safe
please make the columns of the newsletter grid snap to the baseline
I wonder if three columns is too tight at this width
make it two columns, larger type, calmer
thanks, spread looks like a magazine!
that would help the print shop.
where does the footnote numbering restart? it should be per page
set footnotes restart per page
can you convert the footnotes to endnotes at the end of the book
then merge the endnotes into a single numbered list
set endnotes single list continuous
again split by chapter this time, easier to check
tell me how many footnotes we are carrying
highest first: chapters by footnote count
line the endnote numbers up superscript in text
instead of superscript try bracketed numbers
show what changed to the apparatus
